title: RecentTransactionsWidget queries /api/transactions directly
body: The RecentTransactionsWidget component (/admin dashboard) fetches directly from /api/transactions?limit=5 rather than using dashboard-metrics. This is a separate data source from revenue metrics but may also need review if the intent is to show Payment_stats-synced data consistently.
rationale: The issue specifically targets revenue widget empty states. RecentTransactionsWidget is not a revenue widget but shares the same empty-state symptom. Worth reviewing whether it should also use Payment_stats-synced data.
